title: FrontierReplay: Split-Free Exact Prefix Caching for Hybrid Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.26020v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Hybrid language models combine self-attention with recurrent layers whose in-place state updates restrict prefix reuse to exact saved positions. Saving states on a coarse grid wastes reusable prefixes, whereas existing fine-grained exact caches must cut the prefill forward pass at each mid-prompt checkpoint, adding scheduler steps that outweigh the reuse gains under load.   We observe that across multi-turn chat, agent loops, document question answering, and tree search, prefix reuse almost always ends at structural boundaries predictable in advance, such as turn ends and known branch points. We present FrontierReplay, a prefix caching system that materializes exact checkpoints at these boundaries without cutting the prefill. translated_title: FrontierReplay：面向混合语言模型的无分割精确前缀缓存
translated_abstract: 混合语言模型将自注意力机制与循环层相结合，而循环层的原位状态更新使得前缀复用只能发生在已保存的精确位置。在粗粒度网格上保存状态会浪费可复用的前缀，而现有的细粒度精确缓存则必须在提示词中间的每个检查点处截断预填充前向传播，由此增加的调度步骤在负载压力下抵消了复用带来的收益。我们观察到，在多轮对话、智能体循环、文档问答和树搜索等场景中，前缀复用几乎总是终止于可预先预测的结构性边界，例如轮次结束处和已知分支点。我们提出了 FrontierReplay，这是一种前缀缓存系统，它在这些边界处生成精确的检查点，而无需截断预填充过程。在前向传播不中断运行的同时，FrontierReplay 记录循环层输入的一个短窗口，并调用跨层、仅状态的复现内核来构建目标状态，其每 token 的成本比完整重计算低 6-37 倍。
tldr: FrontierReplay 通过在可预测的结构性边界处生成精确检查点并保持预填充前向传播不中断，为混合语言模型实现了无分割的精确前缀缓存，使状态构建成本比完整重计算降低 6-37 倍。
en_tdlr: FrontierReplay enables split-free exact prefix caching for hybrid language models by materializing checkpoints at predictable structural boundaries without cutting the prefill forward pass, reducing state-building cost by 6-37x compared to full recomputation.
